import 'package:adele_ui/environment_capability_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/main_content_bridge.dart';
import 'package:diff_viewer_contract/diff_viewer_contract.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

void initialize() {
  openMainContentPane('portable', 'Independent portable Git', false);
}

Widget buildPane() => PortableGit();

class PortableGit extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  State<PortableGit> createState() => PortableGitState();
}

class PortableGitState extends State<PortableGit> {
  String selection = 'idle';
  String text = 'snapshot:idle';
  dynamic client;
  dynamic approvalClient;
  dynamic unstagedSelection;
  dynamic stagedSelection;
  dynamic unstagedFileSelection;
  dynamic stagedFileSelection;
  bool approvalSelected = false;
  bool unstagedSelected = false;
  bool stagedSelected = false;
  bool unstagedFileSelected = false;
  bool stagedFileSelected = false;
  String approvalSelection = 'approval:idle';
  String approval = 'approval:idle';
  List<String> handles = [];
  bool disposed = false;

  void select(String? provider, String service) async {
    final handle = await resolveEnvironmentBufferedProcessCapabilityProvider(
      'adele.diff.change-set-source',
      1,
      service,
      provider,
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    if (handle == null) {
      setState(() {
        selection = 'selection:unavailable';
      });
      return;
    }
    handles.add(handle);
    client = ChangeSetSourceServiceClient(
      EnvironmentCapabilityRequestChannel(handle),
    );
    setState(() {
      selection = 'selected';
    });
  }

  void snapshot(dynamic selected, String scope) async {
    if (selected == null || disposed) return;
    setState(() {
      text = 'snapshot:pending';
    });
    final ChangeSetSourceServiceClient typed = selected;
    dynamic result;
    if (scope == 'unstaged') {
      result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
        typed.snapshotUnstaged(),
      );
    } else if (scope == 'uncommitted') {
      result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
        typed.snapshotUncommitted(),
      );
    } else {
      result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
        typed.snapshotTaskChanges(),
      );
    }
    if (disposed) return;
    if (result[0] != true) {
      setState(() {
        text = 'snapshot:unavailable';
      });
      return;
    }
    // Decoding and every nested field access happen inside compiled EVC.
    String rendered = 'snapshot';
    if (scope == 'unstaged') {
      final ChangeSetSnapshot value = result[1];
      rememberSelection(value.files, false);
      rendered += renderFiles(value.files);
    } else if (scope == 'uncommitted') {
      final UncommittedChangeSetSnapshot value = result[1];
      rememberSelection(value.staged.files, true);
      rememberSelection(value.unstaged.files, false);
      rendered += '\nstaged' + renderFiles(value.staged.files);
      rendered += '\nunstaged' + renderFiles(value.unstaged.files);
      rendered += '\nconflicts' + renderFiles(value.conflicts);
    } else {
      final TaskChangeSetSnapshot value = result[1];
      rememberSelection(value.uncommitted.staged.files, true);
      rememberSelection(value.uncommitted.unstaged.files, false);
      rendered += '\ncommitted' + renderFiles(value.committed.files);
      rendered += '\nstaged' + renderFiles(value.uncommitted.staged.files);
      rendered += '\nunstaged' + renderFiles(value.uncommitted.unstaged.files);
      rendered += '\nconflicts' + renderFiles(value.uncommitted.conflicts);
    }
    setState(() {
      text = rendered;
    });
  }

  void rememberSelection(List<ChangedFile> files, bool reverse) {
    rememberFileSelection(files, reverse);
    if (reverse) {
      stagedSelected = false;
    } else {
      unstagedSelected = false;
    }
    for (final ChangedFile file in files) {
      if (file.reviewRevision != null && file.hunks.isNotEmpty) {
        final selected = ReviewHunkSelection(
          relativePath: file.relativePath,
          hunkIndex: 0,
          expectedRevision: file.reviewRevision!,
        );
        if (reverse) {
          stagedSelection = selected;
          stagedSelected = true;
        } else {
          unstagedSelection = selected;
          unstagedSelected = true;
        }
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  void rememberFileSelection(List<ChangedFile> files, bool reverse) {
    if (reverse) {
      stagedFileSelected = false;
    } else {
      unstagedFileSelected = false;
    }
    for (final ChangedFile file in files) {
      if (file.fileReviewRevision != null) {
        final selected = ReviewFileSelection(
          relativePath: file.relativePath,
          expectedRevision: file.fileReviewRevision!,
        );
        if (reverse) {
          stagedFileSelection = selected;
          stagedFileSelected = true;
        } else {
          unstagedFileSelection = selected;
          unstagedFileSelected = true;
        }
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  void selectApproval() async {
    final handle = await resolveEnvironmentBufferedProcessCapabilityProvider(
      'adele.diff.review-approval',
      1,
      reviewApprovalHandlerServiceId,
      null,
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    if (handle == null) {
      setState(() {
        approvalSelected = false;
        approvalSelection = 'approval-selection:unavailable';
      });
      return;
    }
    handles.add(handle);
    approvalClient = ReviewApprovalHandlerServiceClient(
      EnvironmentCapabilityRequestChannel(handle),
    );
    setState(() {
      approvalSelected = true;
      approvalSelection = 'approval-selected';
    });
  }

  void review(
    dynamic selected,
    dynamic selection,
    bool reverse,
    bool wholeFile,
  ) async {
    if (selected == null || selection == null || disposed) return;
    setState(() {
      approval = 'approval:pending';
    });
    final ReviewApprovalHandlerServiceClient typed = selected;
    dynamic result;
    if (wholeFile) {
      final ReviewFileSelection file = selection;
      if (reverse) {
        result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
          typed.unapproveFile(file),
        );
      } else {
        result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
          typed.approveFile(file),
        );
      }
    } else {
      final ReviewHunkSelection hunk = selection;
      if (reverse) {
        result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
          typed.unapproveHunk(hunk),
        );
      } else {
        result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
          typed.approveHunk(hunk),
        );
      }
    }
    if (disposed) return;
    setState(() {
      approval = result[0] == true
          ? 'approval:success'
          : 'approval:unavailable';
    });
  }

  String renderFiles(List<ChangedFile> files) {
    String rendered = '';
    for (final ChangedFile file in files) {
      rendered +=
          '\n${file.relativePath}|${file.changeKind}|${file.contentStatus}';
      for (final DiffHunk hunk in file.hunks) {
        rendered +=
            '\n@@${hunk.oldStart},${hunk.oldCount}:${hunk.newStart},${hunk.newCount}';
        for (final DiffLine line in hunk.lines) {
          rendered += '\n${line.kind}:${line.text}:${line.noNewline}';
        }
      }
    }
    return rendered;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    disposed = true;
    for (final handle in handles) {
      releaseEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(handle);
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      Text(selection),
      Text(approvalSelection),
      Text(approval),
      Expanded(
        flex: 1,
        child: ListView.builder(
          itemCount: 1,
          itemBuilder: (context, index) => Text(text),
        ),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          select(null, changeSetSourceServiceId);
        },
        child: Text('Select'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          select('missing', changeSetSourceServiceId);
        },
        child: Text('Missing provider'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          select(null, 'wrong-service');
        },
        child: Text('Wrong service'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          snapshot(client, 'unstaged');
        },
        child: Text('Unstaged'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          snapshot(client, 'uncommitted');
        },
        child: Text('Uncommitted'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          snapshot(client, 'task');
        },
        child: Text('Task'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          selectApproval();
        },
        child: Text('Select approval'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          // The pinned evaluator cannot read an uninitialized dynamic field.
          if (!approvalSelected || !unstagedSelected) return;
          review(approvalClient, unstagedSelection, false, false);
        },
        child: Text('Approve'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          if (!approvalSelected || !stagedSelected) return;
          review(approvalClient, stagedSelection, true, false);
        },
        child: Text('Unapprove'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          if (!approvalSelected || !unstagedFileSelected) return;
          review(approvalClient, unstagedFileSelection, false, true);
        },
        child: Text('Approve File'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          if (!approvalSelected || !stagedFileSelected) return;
          review(approvalClient, stagedFileSelection, true, true);
        },
        child: Text('Unapprove File'),
      ),
    ],
  );
}
